title: Daniel Gockerell triangle sighting

tellings.quote: You never got to hear Daniel Gockerell. Small story, but I had him on Weaponized After. He saw a a triangle.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a UFO researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Daniel Gockerell, who says he saw a triangle-shaped object. Corbell calls it a small story and says he later had Gockerell on his show, Weaponized. He doesn't say when or where the sighting happened.
